item.title: GTA 6 explained for people who have not been following it
item.description: GTA 6 explained in plain English: what Grand Theft Auto VI is, release date, platforms, editions, rating and what is still unknown as of 14 November 2026.
item.content:encoded:
Grand Theft Auto VI, usually written GTA 6 or GTA VI, is the next main game in Rockstar Games' open-world crime series. If you have not followed the news, this page gives you the basics in plain English, and every claim is labelled by how well it is sourced.

What is GTA 6 in one paragraph?

GTA 6 is a single-player-focused action-adventure game set in the fictional US state of Leonida, with Vice City as its main city. Rockstar describes it with the line "Vice City, USA. The darkest side of the sunniest place in America." You play two protagonists, Jason and Lucia, whose story starts when "an easy score goes wrong" and spirals into criminal conspiracies. It is developed by Rockstar Games and published by Take-Two Interactive. The release date is 19 November 2026 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

  • Release date: 19 November 2026 (confirmed by Rockstar and Take-Two).
  • Platforms: PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. No PC version has been announced as of 14 November 2026.
  • Setting: State of Leonida, main city Vice City.
  • Protagonists: Jason and Lucia.

GTA 6 key facts at a glance

Grand Theft Auto VI key facts, status as of 14 November 2026
ItemAnswerStatus
Release date19 November 2026Confirmed
PlatformsPlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|SConfirmed
SettingState of Leonida, Vice CityConfirmed
ProtagonistsJason and LuciaConfirmed
Developer / publisherRockstar Games / Take-Two InteractiveConfirmed
RatingESRB Mature, per Rockstar's official page; PEGI not verifiedESRB confirmed, PEGI unknown
EditionsStandard and Ultimate; Vintage Vice City Pack pre-order bonusNames confirmed
PriceReportedly US$79.99 Standard and US$99.99 UltimateReported
Online modeNone announced; described as a single-player experienceReported
PC versionNot announcedUnknown

Why is everyone talking about GTA 6?

Three things combine. First, the wait: the previous main game, Grand Theft Auto V, came out in 2013, and GTA V has reportedly shipped more than 225 million copies as of the December 2025 quarter. Few entertainment products stay on sale and in the news for that long. Second, the release date moved: according to reports, the game was first aimed at Fall 2025, then 26 May 2026, then 19 November 2026. Rockstar's reported statement said the extra months would allow the team to finish the game "with the level of polish you have come to expect and deserve". Third, the trailers broke records for views, according to reports. Our page on why GTA 6 matters goes into the business and cultural side.

Where and when is it set?

The setting is the state of Leonida, a fictional take on Florida, and its main city is Vice City, a fictional take on Miami. Vice City already appeared in the series: it was the setting of Grand Theft Auto: Vice City in 2002. GTA 6 is a new version of that idea rather than a remake, and Rockstar has not described it as a sequel to the 2002 plot. Vice City also appeared as one of three cities in the 1997 original and in the 2006 prequel Vice City Stories; the full story is on Vice City then and now, and the wider timeline on how the GTA series got here.

Rockstar's website lists other regions, but this site only names Leonida and Vice City because those are the places we have verified against the official page. The same applies to the map: we do not publish a size comparison, because Rockstar has not given one. What we can describe is the real state that inspired the setting: Miami Beach's Art Deco streets, the Everglades, the Florida Keys and a climate with a hurricane season. That real-world background, clearly labelled as such, is on Leonida's Florida roots.

Who are Jason and Lucia?

Rockstar confirms that Jason and Lucia are the two protagonists. Outlets such as GamesRadar report their full names as Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, taken from Rockstar's website update in 2025, and report that Lucia is the first female lead in a main GTA game. The official page frames the story as two people pulled into a crime conspiracy after a job goes wrong. Whether and how you will switch between the two characters has not been confirmed to us, so we do not describe it.

Which platforms can play it?

Only PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S are listed by Rockstar and Take-Two. Rockstar's page reportedly says the game plays best on PlayStation 5, but no PS5 Pro enhancement details have been confirmed. PlayStation 4 and Xbox One versions have not been announced, and neither has a PC version. Any claim about a PC date is speculation. The page on what is still unknown keeps a running list of these gaps.

What do you actually get when you buy it?

There are two editions named by Rockstar, Standard and Ultimate, plus a pre-order bonus called the Vintage Vice City Pack. Reported prices are US$79.99 for Standard and US$99.99 for Ultimate; we have not seen them on an official store page, so check the PlayStation Store, Microsoft Store or Rockstar Games Store before you pay. Reports also say a boxed copy contains a download code instead of a disc. Everything about the choice between editions, with a comparison table, is on editions explained. Pre-orders reportedly opened on 25 June 2026 and digital preload reportedly began on 12 November 2026; how ordering, preloading and launch-day unlocking work is explained in the pre-order and preload guide.

Is it suitable for children?

No, not for young children. The ESRB rating shown on Rockstar's page is Mature, with descriptors for blood and gore, intense violence, mature humor, nudity, strong language, sexual content and use of drugs and alcohol, plus in-game purchases. We have not verified a PEGI rating, so we do not state one. Parents should read the ratings and parental guidance page for the practical steps: console parental controls, spending limits and what the "in-game purchases" label means.

Is there multiplayer?

No GTA VI online mode has been announced as of 14 November 2026. Outlets report that the PlayStation Store FAQ calls the game a single-player experience, which led to commentary about the future of GTA Online, the multiplayer mode of GTA V. There is no official statement about GTA Online ending that we could find. See single-player vs online for a careful reading of what is and is not known.

Which words will you hear?

Fans use shorthand such as "GTA VI", "Leonida", "Vintage Vice City Pack", "preload" and "open world". If a term in a headline confuses you, the GTA glossary explains it in a sentence or two.

How to tell reliable GTA 6 news from rumours

Because the game is so popular, many pages publish guesses as facts. A few quick habits help. Prefer Rockstar's own page and Take-Two's investor filings. Treat a single outlet quoting an unnamed source as unconfirmed. Be suspicious of leaked maps, "system requirements" for consoles, or exact sales figures before the release. Our how we verify facts page lists the labels used on this site: confirmed, reported and unknown. Our team is an independent fan editorial team; see about this site for the disclaimer and privacy details.

Beware scams. Fake "free download", "PC version" and "early access beta" offers circulate around every big launch. No demo, beta or PC version has been announced, and the only places to buy are the official storefronts and retailers. This site does not link to any download. The common tricks, and how to secure your PlayStation or Microsoft account, are in how to avoid GTA 6 scams.

Getting your console ready

Whether you bought a digital copy or a boxed one, the game has to be installed before you can play, and big games need a lot of free space. Rockstar has not published a file size we could verify, so check the figure on your store listing.

Storage and updates

The original PlayStation 5 ships with an 825 GB SSD and later models with more; the Xbox Series S starts at 512 GB and the Series X at 1 TB. Both consoles can add fast expansion storage, but current-generation games cannot be played from an ordinary USB drive. Update the console's system software before release day and allow downloads in rest mode. The step-by-step version is on our console preparation guide.

Comfort and accessibility

Rockstar has not announced GTA VI's own accessibility options. Your console already offers system-wide tools such as larger text, high contrast, button remapping, captions and adaptive controllers, which apply to every game. They are explained, console by console, in our accessibility and settings guide.

GTA 6 timeline in brief

Main GTA 6 milestones
DateEventStatus
December 2023First trailer releasedReported
6 May 2025Second trailer releasedReported
6 November 2025Release moved to 19 November 2026Reported
25 June 2026Pre-orders openedReported
9 November 2026Take-Two reaffirms the date in its earnings releaseConfirmed
12 November 2026Digital preload reportedly startsReported
19 November 2026Release dateConfirmed

On 9 November 2026 Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick said pre-orders were continuing to reach "unprecedented levels", but the company has published no unit numbers. For the official reference, visit Rockstar's GTA VI site.

Where should I start?

  1. New to the series? Read the series history, then the Vice City page.
  2. Deciding what to buy? Use the editions guide, then the preload guide.
  3. Buying for a teenager? Read the parental guidance page and set up family controls first.
  4. Installing on launch week? Clear storage and update your console.
  5. Seen an offer that sounds too good? Check the scams guide before you click.
  6. Wondering about gaps in the news? See what is still unknown.

Facts on this page are current as of 14 November 2026. Release date: 19 November 2026.

item.title: Why does GTA 6 matter so much?
item.description: Why Grand Theft Auto VI is treated as an event: the 13-year gap since GTA V, the delays, record trailer views and what Take-Two says about the launch.
item.content:encoded:
If you have wondered why a video game gets front-page coverage, this page explains the reasons in order: the long gap, the delays, the money and the size of the audience. Each number is marked as confirmed or reported, so you can see how solid it is.

The long wait and the delays

A 13-year gap between main games

The previous main game, Grand Theft Auto V, arrived in 2013. Most big series release a new entry every few years; earlier main GTA games came out one to five years apart. GTA V instead stayed on sale across three console generations, and GTA VI is its first main successor. An entire generation of players grew up with GTA V as "the current GTA". That gap, more than any single feature, explains the attention. To see the games in between and what each changed, read how the GTA series got here.

Three target dates, one launch

According to reports, the game was first planned for Fall 2025, then moved to 26 May 2026 in an announcement made in May 2025, and finally to 19 November 2026, announced on 6 November 2025 alongside Take-Two's earnings. Each move pushed the story back into the headlines. On 9 November 2026 Take-Two reaffirmed the date in its earnings release, so the game was not delayed again. The date is also confirmed on Rockstar's official GTA VI page.

What Rockstar said about the last delay

Rockstar's statement, as quoted by outlets, said: "We are sorry for adding additional time to what we realize has been a long wait, but these extra months will allow us to finish the game with the level of polish you have come to expect and deserve." An apology from a studio that rarely comments is itself unusual, and it was widely shared.

The numbers people quote

Take-Two does not publish GTA 6 sales before launch, and we do not either. What can be stated is the context around it.

Sales and business figures, with source status
FigureDetailStatus
GTA V units shipped225 million as of Take-Two's Q3 fiscal 2026 report (December 2025 quarter)Reported
GTA series totalOver 465 million unitsReported
Take-Two FY2027 net bookings guidanceUS$8.0 to 8.2 billion, maintained on 9 November 2026Confirmed (SEC filing)
GTA VI pre-orders"Unprecedented levels"; no numbers givenConfirmed wording
Trailer 1 viewsAbout 90.4 million YouTube views in 24 hours, a reported Guinness record for a game trailerReported
Trailer 2 viewsAbout 69 million YouTube views in 24 hours; roughly 475 million across platforms per Rockstar-cited figuresReported

Reading the GTA V figure

"Units shipped" counts copies sent to stores and sold digitally over more than a decade, across PlayStation 3, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox and PC versions. A headline claiming GTA V passed 230 million units exists, but we could not check it against Take-Two's own releases, so we keep the 225 million figure. Any pre-launch prediction for GTA VI sales is an estimate, not data.

What Take-Two actually said

In its 9 November 2026 filing, CEO Strauss Zelnick said: "The launch of Grand Theft Auto VI is ten days away and, with pre-orders continuing to reach unprecedented levels, we expect to deliver an historic year for our company." Note what is missing: no unit count, no revenue split by game. The guidance figure covers the whole company, not GTA VI alone.

Trailer records in context

Trailer 1 was published in December 2023 and Trailer 2 on 6 May 2025. View counts differ by platform and counting method, so treat them as reported. We have not researched later 2026 trailers and do not describe them.

Who it matters to, and what the hype hides

  • The publisher: Take-Two named the launch as the driver of an "historic year".
  • Other studios: big releases often avoid the same weeks, so calendars shift around GTA. This is a general industry habit, not a Rockstar announcement.
  • Console owners: the game is listed only for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, which is a reason some people buy or upgrade. How to choose a version is on editions explained, and ordering logistics on the pre-order and preload guide.
  • Parents and the public: the series is controversial because of its mature content, which is why we keep a separate guide on ratings and parental guidance.
  • Fans of the setting: the return of a famous city has its own story, told in Vice City then and now.

How Rockstar communicates

Rockstar shares little: few interviews, a small number of trailers and a website that updates in bursts. Take-Two speaks mostly through investor materials. When information is scarce, fans fill the space with theories, and some of those theories get repeated as news. Knowing that pattern is the best protection against rumours.

The noise around a huge launch

Big attention produces big noise: fake leaks, invented system requirements, "release time" posts presented as official and fake "beta" invitations. Rockstar has not announced a single global unlock time, for example, whatever a viral post says. We track open questions on the unknowns page, and the most common traps are described in how to avoid GTA 6 scams.

Tip: when you see a big number about GTA 6, ask who published it, when, and whether it is a forecast or a count. Our verification method uses the same three questions.

In four lines

  1. The gap since GTA V in 2013 is unusually long.
  2. The previous game is among the best-selling ever, reportedly 225 million units shipped.
  3. Delays raised the stakes; the date of 19 November 2026 is confirmed.
  4. Take-Two calls pre-orders unprecedented but gives no figures.

Return to the main GTA 6 explainer for the key-facts table.

item.title: GTA 6 single-player vs online: where things stand
item.description: Is GTA 6 single-player or online? What is reported about the story mode, whether GTA Online continues and why no multiplayer mode is announced yet.
item.content:encoded:
People often ask whether GTA 6 has multiplayer. The accurate answer as of 14 November 2026 is that no online mode has been announced, and outlets report the game is described as a single-player experience. This page explains what that wording does and does not tell you.

What is confirmed and what is reported

Single-player and online status of GTA VI
TopicStatus as of 14 November 2026Evidence level
Story with Jason and LuciaConfirmed on Rockstar's pageConfirmed
In-game radio stations, open worldConfirmed on Rockstar's pageConfirmed
Described as single-playerReported from the PlayStation Store FAQReported
GTA VI online modeNot announcedUnknown
GTA Online (GTA V) endingNo official statement foundUnknown
Co-op or split-screenNot announcedUnknown
Character switching controlsOne outlet snippet onlyUnverified

What "single-player" means here

A single-player game is one you play alone, following a story at your own pace. Reports quote the PlayStation Store FAQ calling GTA VI a single-player experience, and outlets such as GamesRadar and PC Gamer wrote that an online mode looks unlikely at launch. We could not read the full original text of those reports, so we describe it as reported. The wording leaves room for later additions, and Rockstar has not said either way.

What is the story mode?

Rockstar's page describes two protagonists, Jason and Lucia, in the state of Leonida, and a story that begins when "an easy score goes wrong" and leads into criminal conspiracies. The page also mentions in-game radio stations and an open world centred on Vice City. There is no confirmed story length, mission count or ending structure; those are on what is still unknown.

GTA Online and connection questions

What happens to GTA Online?

GTA Online is the multiplayer mode of the previous game, GTA V, launched in 2013. It continues to exist, and we found no official statement that it will close. It is separate from GTA VI: nothing announced says progress, characters or purchases carry over into the new game. If you play GTA Online now, nothing in the sources we use says you must stop. Its background is on how the GTA series got here.

Do you need an internet connection?

Rockstar has not published online requirements for GTA VI. Console subscriptions such as PlayStation Plus or Xbox Game Pass Core are normally needed for online multiplayer on consoles, but because no online mode is announced, we cannot say whether any would be needed. We also cannot say whether the first launch requires a connection. A download is needed in any case for digital copies and, reportedly, for boxed copies that contain a code. Launch-day updates are common for big releases, which is a general habit rather than a Rockstar statement. Practical download planning is on the console preparation page.

Typical rumours to ignore

Search results often claim "GTA Online 2 is confirmed", list online features, promise a "multiplayer beta" sign-up or show a leaked player count. None of that is in Rockstar's materials. Beta sign-up pages are a known way to steal logins; see how to avoid GTA 6 scams. Claims that you can switch characters with a button press come from one outlet snippet and are unverified, so we do not state them.

Why it matters, and what would change this page

  • For buyers: do not pay extra for an edition on the assumption that it includes online access. See editions explained.
  • For parents: an online mode would bring chat with strangers. None is announced, but the rating label mentions in-game purchases; see ratings and parental guidance.
  • For players with specific needs: a solo game lets you pause and play at your own pace, which matters for comfort settings covered in our accessibility guide.
  • For fans: Rockstar could announce updates or modes at any time, so check official channels instead of rumours.

How to read future announcements

If Rockstar announces a multiplayer mode, look for three things: a name, a platform list and a date. Be careful with "coming soon" posts without a source. An online mode could also bring its own purchases and communication features, so parents would need to revisit their console settings.

What would make us update

We will revise this page if Rockstar or Take-Two announce an online mode, other modes, or a closing date for GTA Online. Until then the correct reading is cautious: story-focused, no online mode announced. Compare with the official site at rockstargames.com/VI.

Short version: GTA VI is reported as single-player; no multiplayer is announced; GTA Online for GTA V has not been officially said to end.

More background is in the GTA 6 explainer.

item.title: GTA 6 editions explained: what you actually get
item.description: What you get with GTA 6 Standard and Ultimate editions, the Vintage Vice City Pack, reported prices, boxed vs digital copies and what to check before paying.
item.content:encoded:
Buying a big game can be confusing. This page explains the GTA 6 editions in plain terms, separates official names from reported details and lists what to check before you pay. Ordering and download timing have their own page, the pre-order and preload guide.

Standard, Ultimate and the bonus pack

The short answer

Rockstar's official page names two editions of Grand Theft Auto VI, Standard and Ultimate, and a pre-order bonus called the Vintage Vice City Pack. Outlets, including The National, report prices of US$79.99 for Standard and US$99.99 for Ultimate. We have not seen those prices on an official store page, so use them as a guide only. The game releases on 19 November 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Editions of GTA 6, with confirmation status
QuestionStandardUltimate
Edition name confirmed by RockstarYesYes
Reported US priceUS$79.99US$99.99
Reported price difference-US$20 more than Standard
Contents beyond the base gameNot verified by usNot verified by us
PlatformsPS5, Xbox Series X|SPS5, Xbox Series X|S
Online mode includedNone announcedNone announced

The honest summary: Rockstar confirms the names, while the contents of each edition and the exact prices should be read from the store you plan to use. We do not list extra items for Ultimate because we could not verify them. Prices in other countries and currencies are not covered by our sources.

The Vintage Vice City Pack

The Vintage Vice City Pack is the confirmed name of the pre-order bonus. According to The National's report, it includes a 1955 Vapid Stanier car, outfits and weapon designs, and was offered for orders placed before 20 November. A single aggregator also mentions one month of GTA+ with a digital pre-order; we treat that as unverified. Because the pre-order window may have closed by the time you read this, check whether the pack is still listed. The name nods to the city's past, explained on Vice City then and now.

Format, platform and price questions

Boxed copy or digital?

The National reports that the boxed copy contains a download code rather than a game disc. We could not confirm that on a store page, so read the product description before you buy a boxed copy. If a physical disc matters to you, for example to resell or lend it later, check what is inside the box. If you prefer digital, buy directly from the console store so the game is tied to your account. Either way you will need free storage space; plan it with our console preparation guide.

PC, PS4, PS5 Pro or a demo?

No PC version, demo, beta, PlayStation 4 or Xbox One version has been announced as of 14 November 2026. Rockstar's page reportedly says the game plays best on PlayStation 5, but we found no official PS5 Pro enhancement list. These gaps are tracked on what is still unknown.

What to do if the price differs

Store prices vary by country, tax and currency, and may change. If the price you see differs from the reported US figures, trust the official store. Retailers also differ in what they include with a pre-order, so read the small print and keep the order confirmation until the game is working. A big discount on a brand-new game from an unofficial seller is a warning sign; the common tricks are listed in how to avoid GTA 6 scams.

Buying it as a gift

Digital gifting options differ by store, and a digital copy is tied to the account that redeems it, so check that the person uses the same platform and region as the store you buy from. A boxed copy avoids the account question, but if it holds a download code, as reported, the code still needs an internet connection and storage space on the recipient's console.

Does the edition affect online play?

No GTA VI online mode has been announced, so no edition is described as unlocking one. The rating label mentions in-game purchases, but Rockstar has not explained what they are. See single-player vs online.

Before you pay

  1. Confirm your console: PlayStation 5 or Xbox Series X|S. The two versions are not interchangeable.
  2. Open the official store listing and read the edition name and price in your currency.
  3. Read what the listing says about the pre-order bonus and whether it is still offered.
  4. For a boxed copy, check whether it holds a disc or a code.
  5. Check the age rating and spending settings if the console is shared with a child, as explained in ratings and parental guidance.

Warning: keys at suspiciously low prices, "free download" offers and anything asking for your console login are scams or break store terms. This site links to no such offers. Use official storefronts.

Verdict: if you only want the game and are unsure, start from Standard and read the official listing for what Ultimate adds. Do not pay extra on the basis of rumours. Official information is at rockstargames.com/VI.

For general background, return to the GTA 6 explainer.

item.title: Pre-ordering and preloading GTA 6, step by step
item.description: How GTA 6 pre-orders and preloading work: reported dates, where to order, the Vintage Vice City Pack, boxed copies with codes and what to do on launch day.
item.content:encoded:
Pre-orders and preloads are routine for big console releases, but the words get mixed up. This guide walks through each stage for Grand Theft Auto VI, from placing the order to pressing start on 19 November 2026, and marks every date by how well it is sourced.

The pre-order and preload timeline

The release date of 19 November 2026 is confirmed by Rockstar and was reaffirmed by Take-Two on 9 November 2026. The steps before it come from news reports, so read them as a guide and confirm the details on your own store listing.

GTA 6 ordering and download milestones, with source status
StageDateStatus
Pre-orders open25 June 2026Reported by The National
Digital preload starts12 November 2026Reported by The National
Pre-order bonus cut-offOrders before 20 NovemberReported
Release date19 November 2026Confirmed
Unlock timeNo single global time announcedUnknown

Where pre-orders were taken

According to The National, pre-orders opened on 25 June 2026 through the PlayStation Store, the Microsoft Store, the Rockstar Games Store and retailers. Take-Two has not published pre-order numbers; its 9 November 2026 earnings release only says pre-orders continue "to reach unprecedented levels". If you see a precise pre-order count online, it did not come from the publisher.

What a pre-order actually is

A pre-order is a purchase made before release. On console storefronts it usually puts the game in your library straight away, greyed out until launch. At a retailer it reserves a boxed copy for delivery or collection. Payment timing differs: some stores charge at once, others close to release. Which edition you reserve is a separate decision, covered in Standard vs Ultimate explained.

The Vintage Vice City Pack

The Vintage Vice City Pack is the pre-order bonus named on Rockstar's official page. The National reports that it includes a 1955 Vapid Stanier, outfits and weapon designs, and that it was offered for orders placed before 20 November. A one-month GTA+ offer mentioned by a single aggregator is unverified, so do not count on it. If you order after launch, check the listing to see whether the pack is still part of the deal.

How preloading works

A preload copies the game files to your console before release, so you are not waiting for a large download on launch day. The game stays locked until the store's unlock moment. Preloading only applies to digital copies and to boxed copies once their code has been redeemed.

Before the download starts

  • Check the account: the preload appears on the console account that owns the pre-order. Buying on one profile and playing on another is a common cause of a missing download.
  • Check free space: Rockstar has not published a file size we could verify, so plan with a margin. The console preparation guide covers storage in detail.
  • Turn on automatic downloads: both PS5 and Xbox Series X|S can download in rest or standby mode if the setting is enabled.
  • Keep the console updated: a pending system update can pause game downloads.

Boxed copies and download codes

The National reports that the boxed edition contains a download code rather than a game disc. We have not confirmed this on a store page, so read the product description. If the report is correct, a boxed copy behaves like a digital purchase once the code is redeemed: you download the game to the console, and you cannot install it from the box. Redeem codes only in the official console store, never on a third-party "activation" site; the scam warning guide explains why.

Unlock time and launch-day patches

Rockstar has not announced one global unlock time. Posts that name an exact hour for every country are not backed by an official source. The reliable place to look is your own store listing, which shows the release in your region. Big releases also often receive an update on launch day. That is a general industry habit rather than a Rockstar statement, but it is a good reason to leave the console online and allow time for one more download. Unknown details like this are tracked on what is still unknown.

Tip: after the preload, open the game's page in your library. If it shows as fully installed and only waiting for the release, you are ready.

Changes, cancellations and launch day

Cancelling or changing an order

Each store has its own rules for cancelling a pre-order, changing edition or getting a refund, and those rules can change. We do not summarise them because they differ by platform and country. Read the policy of the store you used before you act, and keep your order confirmation email until the game is installed and working. Upgrading edition usually means buying the other edition or an upgrade offered in the store, if one exists.

A short launch-day checklist

  1. Confirm the game shows as installed or ready in your library.
  2. Install any pending console system update first.
  3. Connect to the internet so the store can verify the licence and any launch update can download.
  4. If you share the console with a child, review the family settings explained in ratings and parental guidance.
  5. If something fails, use the official support channels of your platform or Rockstar, not a stranger offering help in a comment thread.

Buying after release

Nothing about the game requires a pre-order. After 19 November 2026 the same stores sell the game normally; the only differences are the pre-order bonus terms and the convenience of a preload. Platform and price questions are summarised on the GTA 6 explainer home page, and the official listing remains at Rockstar's GTA VI site.

In short: pre-ordering secures the game and the reported bonus; preloading saves time on launch day. Neither changes what the game contains.

item.title: GTA 6 age rating and guidance for parents
item.description: GTA 6 ESRB Mature rating explained, what the content descriptors mean, PEGI status, parental controls and spending limits for parents on PS5 and Xbox.
item.content:encoded:
If a teenager has asked you for GTA 6, you probably want a straight answer. The game is rated for mature audiences, and this page shows what that means and which console tools can help. It is general guidance, not a review of the game.

What the rating says

Age ratings for Grand Theft Auto VI, as of 14 November 2026
SystemRatingStatus
ESRB (US and Canada)MatureDisplayed on Rockstar's official page
ESRB interactive elementIn-game purchasesDisplayed on Rockstar's official page
PEGI (Europe)Not verifiedWe do not state a PEGI age
Other regionsNot checkedCheck your local rating board

The ESRB descriptors shown on Rockstar's page are blood and gore, intense violence, mature humor, nudity, strong language, sexual content and use of drugs and alcohol. One outlet reports the rating was published on 6 October 2026; we treat that date as reported only.

What the descriptors mean in practice

Blood and gore, intense violence

Expect graphic violence in missions and in the open world. Younger players should not play.

Strong language and mature humor

Frequent swearing and adult jokes, which are part of the series' satire.

Nudity and sexual content

Adult themes are present. The rating does not say how often or how explicit; we have not played the game.

Drugs and alcohol

Characters use drugs and alcohol in the story. Depiction is not endorsement.

"Mature" means what age?

The ESRB describes Mature as content generally suitable for ages 17 and up. That is the board's general definition, not something specific to this game. PEGI uses different age bands and is not verified for GTA 6, so do not rely on social media posts claiming a PEGI number. Every main GTA game has carried a mature rating; the series history shows why the controversy is old news.

What are "in-game purchases"?

The label means the game offers purchases of extra content or currency for real money. Rockstar has not explained what those are in GTA VI, and no online mode is announced, so we cannot say how large they are. Set a spending limit regardless. For the current state of online features, see single-player vs online.

Parental controls on PS5 and Xbox

A practical checklist

  1. Create a child account on the console, linked to your family or parent account.
  2. Set an age limit for games, so a Mature title cannot start under that account.
  3. Restrict purchases: require approval, set a monthly spending cap, or keep the child's wallet at zero.
  4. Manage playtime: both PlayStation and Xbox offer play-time schedules in their family tools.
  5. Check communication settings: if an online mode ever appears, review chat and friend requests before allowing it.

Where to find the settings

On PlayStation 5 the controls sit under Family and Parental Controls in the console settings, and can also be managed from a parent's account in the PlayStation app or website. On Xbox Series X|S they are managed through the Xbox Family Settings app or the family area of a Microsoft account. Menu names change with system updates, so use the console's own help pages for the exact steps. Other console basics, such as storage and system updates, are on the console preparation page, and comfort and display options are on our accessibility settings guide.

Tip: talk with your child about why a game is rated Mature. A rating works best alongside a conversation and clear household rules.

Gifts and shared consoles

If you buy the game as a gift, the edition does not change the rating; see editions explained. On a shared console, a Mature game can appear in everyone's library, so set the age limit on each child's account, not just on yours.

Making the decision

Should my child play it?

That is a family decision. Our editorial position is simple: the ESRB Mature rating is the official signal, so GTA 6 is not intended for children. If a teenager is close to 17, read independent reviews published after release and, if you can, watch some gameplay yourself. Independent reviews will describe the actual content in more detail than any label.

Questions to ask before you decide

  • Has my child played other Mature-rated games, and how did we handle it?
  • Do I know which friends play it and how they talk about it?
  • Are console time limits and purchase approvals already set up?
  • Is there a shared family space where the game would be played?

These questions start a household conversation. They are not a rating system, and no checklist replaces your judgement about a particular child.

Scams that target young players

Teenagers are a common target for fake "free GTA 6" offers, fake giveaways and phishing messages that ask for console logins. Our guide on avoiding GTA 6 scams is worth reading together.

Where to read the official label

The most reliable source is the rating on Rockstar's own page at rockstargames.com/VI and on your platform's store listing. Ratings can be updated, so look at the date. Open rating questions are kept in what is still unknown.

item.title: Getting your console ready for Grand Theft Auto VI
item.description: How to get a PS5 or Xbox Series X|S ready for GTA 6: storage planning, expansion drives, system updates, rest mode downloads, account region and network checks.
item.content:encoded:
Grand Theft Auto VI is released on 19 November 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Most launch-day frustration has nothing to do with the game itself: a full drive, a pending system update or a payment card that fails. This page walks through the console side so the download and first launch go smoothly.

What we do not know: Rockstar has not published a GTA VI file size that we could verify, and no console "system requirements" exist beyond the platform list. Any exact gigabyte figure you see on social media should be checked against your own store listing, which shows the size before you download.

Storage: how much room do you really have?

Console boxes list the raw drive size, but part of it is reserved for the operating system. The figures below are the general hardware specifications published by Sony and Microsoft, not anything specific to GTA 6.

Built-in storage on current consoles that can play GTA VI
ConsoleAdvertised storageHow to add more
PlayStation 5 (original model)825 GB SSD, roughly 667 GB usableM.2 SSD slot inside the console
PlayStation 5 Slim1 TB SSDM.2 SSD slot
PlayStation 5 Pro2 TB SSDM.2 SSD slot
Xbox Series X1 TB SSD, roughly 800 GB usableStorage Expansion Card slot on the back
Xbox Series S512 GB SSD (a 1 TB model also exists)Storage Expansion Card slot

Free up space the sensible way

  • Open the storage screen in Settings and sort installed games by size. Large games you have finished are the obvious candidates.
  • Remember that deleting a digital game does not delete the licence. You can download it again later from your library.
  • Check saved video clips and screenshots. Captures pile up quietly, especially on PS5.
  • Save data is small and usually backed up to the cloud if you have a subscription, but confirm before deleting a game you might return to.

Expansion drives and USB drives

On PS5, a compatible M.2 NVMe SSD installed in the internal slot works exactly like the built-in drive, so you can play PS5 games from it. Sony's support pages list the supported sizes and recommend a heatsink. A USB drive on PS5 can store PS5 games and play PS4 games, but PS5 games must be copied back to internal or M.2 storage before you play them.

On Xbox Series X|S, the Storage Expansion Card behaves like internal storage. A regular USB drive can play older Xbox One titles, but games built for Series X|S have to run from the internal drive or the expansion card. GTA VI is a current-generation game, so plan on internal or expansion storage for playing it.

Updates, downloads and the first launch

Update the console first

New releases often expect the latest system software. Install any pending console update a few days before 19 November 2026 rather than on release night, when servers are busiest. On both consoles, automatic system updates can be switched on in Settings.

Let downloads run while the console sleeps

PS5 calls its low-power state Rest Mode; Xbox offers a sleep or standby power mode. Both can keep downloading game files and patches while the screen is off, as long as the relevant option is enabled. Turn on automatic game updates as well, because big games commonly receive a patch at or near launch. That is a general industry habit, not a Rockstar announcement for GTA VI. When and how pre-loading works is explained on our pre-order and preload guide.

Wired beats wireless for big downloads

  1. If you can, connect the console to the router with an Ethernet cable.
  2. Run the console's built-in network test to see your download speed.
  3. Pause other large downloads in the house, such as PC game updates or cloud backups.
  4. If the speed is very low on launch day, the problem may be store traffic rather than your connection; try again later.

Accounts, region and payment

Check the account that owns the game

A digital copy is tied to the account that bought it. On a shared console, make sure you buy with the account that will play, or that the console is set as the primary or home console for that account, so other profiles can use the licence. If the console is shared with children, set up family settings before release; our ratings and parental guidance page explains the Mature rating and spending limits.

Region and payment basics

Store accounts are linked to a country, which sets the currency and the price you see. Do not create an account in another region to chase a lower price: it can break payment methods and may conflict with store terms. Update an expired card or add wallet funds through the official store before launch week. Reported prices are covered in editions explained, and fake "cheap key" offers in our guide to avoiding GTA 6 scams.

  • Platforms: PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S (confirmed).
  • PC, PS4, Xbox One: not announced as of 14 November 2026.
  • PS5 Pro enhancements: no official details found.
  • File size: not verified; read it on your store listing.

Comfort and readability settings, such as text size and controller remapping, have their own page: accessibility and settings basics. For anything Rockstar has not answered yet, see what is still unknown, and compare with the official GTA VI site. New to the game? Start at the GTA 6 explainer.

item.title: Accessibility and comfort settings for GTA 6 players
item.description: GTA 6 accessibility: what is not announced yet, plus the PS5 and Xbox settings for text, contrast, audio, captions, remapping and motion comfort to use now.
item.content:encoded:
Players with low vision, hearing loss, limited mobility or motion sensitivity want to know one thing before buying: will I be able to play comfortably? For Grand Theft Auto VI, the honest answer starts with a gap. Rockstar has not published a list of in-game accessibility options as of 14 November 2026. What you can control today is the console, and both PS5 and Xbox Series X|S offer far more than many people realise.

Not announced: subtitle styles, colour-blind modes, aim assistance levels, difficulty options and control remapping inside GTA VI have not been detailed by Rockstar. Lists claiming to describe the game's settings menu are guesses until the game or an official page shows them. Independent reviews and accessibility-focused writers usually cover this soon after release.

Console tools you can switch on now

These system-level settings apply across games and menus. Names below are the ones Sony and Microsoft use in their Settings apps; menus move around after system updates, so use the search or help function on your console if a label differs.

Accessibility features built into PS5 and Xbox Series X|S
NeedPlayStation 5Xbox Series X|S
Reading menus aloudScreen ReaderNarrator
Larger or bolder textText size, bold text, zoomText size, Magnifier
Contrast and colourHigh contrast, colour correction, invert coloursHigh contrast, colour filters
Fewer animationsReduce motionAnimation and motion options in accessibility settings
Hearing supportMono audio, closed captions for system media, chat transcriptionMono output, closed captions, party chat speech-to-text
Button layoutCustom button assignmentsButton remapping in the Xbox Accessories app
Alternative hardwareAccess controllerXbox Adaptive Controller, Copilot (two controllers as one)

Vision

Screen Reader on PS5 and Narrator on Xbox read out system menus, store pages and notifications, which helps with buying, installing and updating a game. Whether they read GTA VI's own menus depends on Rockstar's implementation, which is not announced. Text size, high contrast and colour filters affect system screens; colour filters on Xbox and colour correction on PS5 can also tint the whole picture, including games, which some players with colour vision deficiency find useful.

Hearing

Mono audio sends both stereo channels to each ear, useful if you hear well on one side only. Visual cues matter a great deal in open-world games, where sirens and radio chatter carry information, so in-game subtitles will be the key setting once the game's menu is known. Earlier Rockstar games, including GTA V, offered subtitles for dialogue, so it is reasonable to look for them, but their exact options in GTA VI are not confirmed.

Mobility and controllers

Both consoles let you swap buttons at system level. Sony's Access controller, released in December 2023, is a configurable pad designed for players who find a standard controller hard to hold. Microsoft's Xbox Adaptive Controller, launched in 2018, accepts external switches and buttons, and Copilot lets a second person help with the same inputs. System remapping can clash with a game's own layout, so after release, check the in-game controls screen and test a few minutes before changing many buttons.

Comfort, motion and long sessions

If camera movement makes you queasy

  • Sit further from the screen and keep the room lit rather than playing in the dark.
  • Look in the game's settings, once available, for camera shake, motion blur, field of view or camera distance options. Many open-world games include some of these, but GTA VI's list is not announced.
  • Driving at speed in third person is a common trigger. Short sessions with breaks help most people adjust.
  • Stop at the first sign of nausea. Pushing through usually makes it worse.

Breaks and play time

Big story games invite very long sessions. Both consoles show play time and let you set schedules or reminders through family and account settings; adults can use the same tools on their own account. A break every hour is a simple habit for eyes, wrists and posture.

Reading the screen from the sofa

If on-screen text is hard to read, check the TV's picture mode before anything else. A "game" mode reduces input lag, and turning off overscan or zoom stops the edges of the picture, where maps and prompts often sit, from being cut off. HDR calibration screens on both consoles are worth a minute too.

Before and after you buy

A short checklist

  1. Set up system-level text, contrast and audio options now, before launch.
  2. Configure any adaptive controller and test remapping in a game you already own.
  3. After 19 November 2026, read the game's settings menu or an accessibility review before deciding how to play.
  4. If the console is shared, give each player a profile so personal settings do not get overwritten.

Bottom line: the console gives you a solid base today. The game's own accessibility menu is the missing piece, and we will not describe it until it is official on Rockstar's GTA VI page or visible in the released game.

Related reading: storage and update steps in console prep, timing in the pre-order and preload guide, and family controls in ratings and parental guidance. For the wider list of gaps, see what is still unknown; gaming jargon is decoded in the glossary. Back to the GTA 6 overview.

item.title: How to avoid GTA 6 scams and fake offers
item.description: How to spot GTA 6 scams: fake betas, free PC downloads, early access offers, cheap keys, login phishing and livestream giveaways, plus how to secure and report.
item.content:encoded:
Scammers follow attention, and few games have drawn more of it than Grand Theft Auto VI. The tricks are rarely new: they recycle the same promises of free copies, secret test versions and cheap keys. Knowing what officially exists is the fastest defence, because most scams offer something that has never been announced.

  • Real: GTA VI on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, released 19 November 2026, sold through official stores and retailers.
  • Not announced as of 14 November 2026: a PC version, a demo, a public beta or a "tester" programme.
  • So: any "GTA 6 PC download", "beta key" or "early tester invite" is fake by definition.

The common GTA 6 scams

Typical GTA 6 scam offers and the warning signs
OfferWhat actually happensRed flag
"Free GTA 6 download" or "GTA 6 PC"Malware, adware or a paid "unlock" that never worksNo PC version is announced
"Beta access" or "early tester" sign-upHarvests your email, password or payment detailsNo beta or demo is announced
Ultra-cheap key or accountInvalid or stolen code, revoked laterPrice far below official stores
Login "verification" messagePhishing page copies your console account passwordLink to an unfamiliar domain, urgent tone
Livestream giveaway with a QR codeCrypto "doubling" or payment scamAsks you to send money or connect a wallet first
"Leaked map" or "mod menu" fileExecutable with malware, or a survey loopMust disable antivirus or install an app

Fake downloads and PC versions

Search results and video descriptions promise a "GTA 6 PC download" or an "APK" for phones. Neither exists officially. These sites usually push installers that carry malware, or ask you to complete endless "human verification" surveys that earn the site money. Because no PC version has been announced, there is nothing legitimate they could be offering. This site does not link to any download, and we never will.

Fake betas and early access

Rockstar has announced no public beta, demo or early access programme. Emails and Discord messages inviting you to "test GTA 6 before release" are phishing. Real pre-release options are limited to the official pre-order and preload process, explained in our pre-order and preload guide.

Cheap keys and shared accounts

Unofficial key sellers and "shared account" offers carry real risk: codes bought with stolen cards get revoked, and logging into someone else's account breaks store terms and can get it locked. Reports say boxed copies contain a download code, which makes resold codes even harder to check. Buy from the PlayStation Store, Microsoft Store, Rockstar Games Store or a known retailer. Reported prices are on editions explained; if an offer is wildly below them, walk away.

Livestream, QR code and social giveaways

Fake "official" streams often loop old trailer footage with a QR code that promises free copies or crypto rewards. Rockstar does not ask fans to send money or connect a crypto wallet to win anything. On social media, accounts with names close to Rockstar's may "pick winners" and then ask for a shipping fee or your login.

Lock down your accounts

Five settings worth ten minutes

  1. Turn on 2-step verification for your PlayStation Network account, your Microsoft account and your Rockstar Games Social Club account.
  2. Use a unique, long password for each one; a password manager helps.
  3. Add a purchase password or approval so a stolen session cannot buy content.
  4. Review connected devices and sign out of any you do not recognise.
  5. Remove saved cards you no longer use from store wallets.

How to recognise phishing

  • The message creates urgency: "verify within 24 hours or lose your pre-order".
  • The link goes to a domain that only looks like Sony, Microsoft or Rockstar.
  • It asks for a password, a 2-step code or payment details. Real support never asks for your code.
  • It arrives through a direct message rather than the console or store itself.

When in doubt, do not click. Open the store or console settings yourself and check whether anything is actually wrong.

If something goes wrong

Report and recover

Change the password at once from a device you trust, then sign out of all sessions. Contact the platform's official support through its own app or website, and report the scam message, video or account on the platform where you found it. If you paid by card, call your bank. If you installed a file, run a security scan and remove it.

Rule of thumb: if an offer for GTA VI is free, early or for PC, it is not real. Check the official GTA VI page before believing any announcement you see in a video description.

For a broader method of judging claims, see how we verify facts, and for open questions such as a PC release, see what is still unknown. Parents setting up purchase limits can use our parental guidance, and storage tips are in getting your console ready. More basics are on the GTA 6 explainer.

item.title: How the GTA series got to GTA 6
item.description: A beginner's history of Grand Theft Auto from the 1997 original to GTA V and GTA VI, with a table of the main games, the eras and where Vice City fits in.
item.content:encoded:
You do not need to have played earlier games to enjoy a new Grand Theft Auto, because each main entry tells a separate story. Still, knowing the history explains why GTA VI is such a big deal, why Vice City sounds familiar and why the wait felt so long.

Note on sourcing: the release years and names below are long-established public history, not items from the GTA VI fact sheet we use for news. GTA VI details are checked separately; see how we verify facts.

The main games in order

Main Grand Theft Auto games, their settings and protagonists
GameYearMain settingLead character(s)
Grand Theft Auto1997Liberty City, San Andreas and Vice CitySelectable characters
Grand Theft Auto 21999Anywhere CityClaude Speed
Grand Theft Auto III2001Liberty CityClaude
Grand Theft Auto: Vice City2002Vice City, 1986Tommy Vercetti
Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas2004State of San Andreas, early 1990sCarl "CJ" Johnson
Grand Theft Auto IV2008Liberty CityNiko Bellic
Grand Theft Auto V2013Los Santos and Blaine CountyMichael, Franklin and Trevor
Grand Theft Auto VI19 November 2026State of Leonida, Vice CityJason and Lucia

There were also expansions and spin-offs, such as Grand Theft Auto: London 1969 (1999), Liberty City Stories (2005), Vice City Stories (2006), the two GTA IV episodes of 2009 and Chinatown Wars (2009). The table lists the games most people mean by "the series". Each main game has a self-contained plot, so you can start with GTA VI.

A quick way to remember the eras

  • Top-down era (1997 to 1999): the original game and its sequel, seen from above, made by DMA Design, the Scottish studio later renamed Rockstar North.
  • 3D era (2001 to 2006): Grand Theft Auto III, Vice City and San Andreas defined the series most people recognise, on PlayStation 2 first.
  • HD era (2008 to 2013): Grand Theft Auto IV and V brought modern graphics, a more grounded tone and online play.
  • Current era (2026): Grand Theft Auto VI on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

These labels are our own shorthand for readers, not official terms.

Why the gap before GTA VI is unusual

Between 1997 and 2013 a new main game appeared every one to five years. The 13 years between GTA V and GTA VI are the exception. During that time GTA V was re-released for PlayStation 4 and Xbox One in 2014, for PC in 2015 and for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S in 2022, which kept it in the charts. The commercial side is on why GTA 6 matters.

What stays the same and what changed

The constants

  • An open world: a large city or region you can explore freely, on foot or in vehicles.
  • Story missions plus side activities: a main plot you can follow in order, and optional things to do.
  • Satire of modern life: radio, adverts and television inside the game poke fun at real culture.
  • A mature rating: violence, strong language and adult themes. Details in ratings and parental guidance.

What GTA V changed

GTA V let players switch between three protagonists during the story and, from October 2013, added GTA Online, a separate multiplayer mode that has been updated for years. Outlets report that GTA V reached 225 million units shipped by the December 2025 quarter, and the franchise more than 465 million. That success is part of why the follow-up took so long and why expectations are so high.

Where Vice City fits

Vice City was one of the three cities in the 1997 original and then the setting of the 2002 game Grand Theft Auto: Vice City. GTA VI uses the name again as the main city of the state of Leonida. This is a new game with new characters, not a remake, and Rockstar has not confirmed any story connection to earlier plots. The full story of the city, from 1997 to today, is on Vice City then and now, and the real places behind the new state are described in Leonida's Florida roots.

What is different in GTA VI, and how to catch up

Two protagonists

Jason and Lucia are confirmed. GTA V had three; earlier games usually had one.

A return to Vice City

The city is confirmed as the main location inside the state of Leonida.

New hardware

PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S only, as of 14 November 2026.

Single-player focus

Reported as a single-player experience, with no online mode announced. See single-player vs online.

Do I need to play older games first?

No. Rockstar builds each main entry as a separate story. If you want a taste of the series first, GTA V is the most recent, but this is a personal choice rather than a requirement. Buy older games only from official stores.

How critics and fans describe the series

Fans praise the scale and detail of the worlds and the radio stations. Critics often point to the controversy around violence and the way each game satirises society. Both views are part of the series story, and each new game revives the debate. We do not give review scores for GTA VI. Terms such as "open world" and "sandbox" are explained in the GTA glossary.

Comparisons to watch for

After launch, people will compare GTA VI with GTA V. Comparisons about map size, number of missions or hours of play need official numbers, and none has been published by Rockstar. Those items sit on the unknowns page until they are answered. For the basics go back to the GTA 6 explainer, or check the official GTA VI site.

item.title: Vice City through the years
item.description: The history of Vice City in Grand Theft Auto: the 1997 original, Vice City in 2002, Vice City Stories, the 2021 remaster and its return as GTA 6's main city.
item.content:encoded:
When Rockstar revealed that Grand Theft Auto VI returns to Vice City, long-time players recognised the name at once. This page traces the city through earlier games and separates what is known about the new version from fan assumptions. The game history here is long-established public knowledge, not part of our GTA VI fact sheet.

Vice City before GTA 6

Vice City has appeared in several forms. Each version is a separate creation, built for its own game and era, so knowing one does not tell you the layout of another.

Appearances of Vice City in the Grand Theft Auto series
GameReleasedPeriod depictedNotes
Grand Theft Auto1997ContemporaryOne of three cities, seen from above
Grand Theft Auto: Vice City20021986First 3D version; protagonist Tommy Vercetti
Grand Theft Auto: Vice City Stories2006 (PSP)1984Prequel; PS2 version followed
The Trilogy: The Definitive Edition20211986Remaster of the 2002 game with GTA III and San Andreas
Grand Theft Auto VI19 November 2026Not specified by RockstarMain city of the state of Leonida

1997: one of three cities

The original Grand Theft Auto had three fictional cities: Liberty City, San Andreas and Vice City. All three later became settings for whole games. In 1997 the city was a top-down grid of streets, and the Miami flavour was mostly in the name and the sunny palette.

2002: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City

Vice City arrived on PlayStation 2 in 2002, with PC and Xbox versions after it. It moved the series to 1986 and followed Tommy Vercetti, a criminal building an empire in a neon city of beaches, pastel buildings and speedboats. Its licensed 1980s soundtrack and radio stations became one of the most remembered parts of the series. For the wider sequence of games, see the GTA series history.

2006: Vice City Stories

Vice City Stories was released for the PlayStation Portable in 2006 and came to PlayStation 2 the following year. A prequel set in 1984, it followed Victor Vance, a character first seen in the 2002 game. It showed that the setting could carry more than one story.

2021: the Definitive Edition

In 2021 Rockstar released Grand Theft Auto: The Trilogy, The Definitive Edition, a remaster of GTA III, Vice City and San Andreas. It brought the 2002 Vice City to current hardware of the time, so many younger players met the city there rather than on PS2.

What inspired the city

The real-world model is Miami, Florida. This is the commonly accepted reading of the city's beaches, art deco hotels and Latin American influences, and the 2002 game leaned heavily on 1980s pop culture.

Miami in the 1980s, as pop culture saw it

Critics and fans have long linked the 2002 game to Miami-set crime television and films of the 1980s: pastel suits, fast boats, synth music and a city portrayed as glamorous and corrupt at once. Those links are interpretation by commentators, not statements we have from Rockstar, and they describe a screen image of Miami rather than the real city. The real geography that also shapes the new state is covered in Leonida's real Florida roots.

Beaches and hotels

Ocean-front strips with pastel art deco buildings, modelled on Miami Beach.

Music and radio

In-game radio was central in 2002. Radio stations are confirmed again for GTA VI.

Satire

Adverts, talk shows and TV mock the excess of the era being depicted.

Vice City in GTA 6

Rockstar's tagline for the new game is "Vice City, USA. The darkest side of the sunniest place in America." Vice City is confirmed as the main city of the state of Leonida, and Jason and Lucia are the confirmed protagonists. That is the solid core.

New game, not a remake

GTA VI is a new game with new characters. Rockstar has not described it as a remake of the 2002 game or as a sequel to its plot, and it has not confirmed any story link to Tommy Vercetti or Victor Vance. Fan videos about "connections" are theories. The same caution applies to the layout: Rockstar has not published a map or a size comparison with the old city.

What we do not state

  • No map size or district list, because Rockstar has not published one we verified.
  • No claims about returning characters, landmarks or businesses from earlier games.
  • No time period: Rockstar has not given an official year for the setting.
  • Other region names in Leonida, which Rockstar's site lists but we have not verified.

Old games and the new one share a name, not a map. Treat any "same street, same building" comparison as fan analysis until Rockstar shows otherwise.

If you want to visit the old city first

You do not need to play the 2002 game to follow GTA VI. If you are curious, buy older games only through official stores; "free download" offers are covered in how to avoid GTA 6 scams. Unfamiliar terms such as "remaster" are in the GTA glossary, open questions about the new map are on what is still unknown, and the official reference is rockstargames.com/VI. For the basics of the new game, start at the GTA 6 explainer.

item.title: The real Florida behind Leonida
item.description: Leonida is GTA 6's fictional take on Florida. A guide to the real places, climate and culture behind it, clearly separated from what Rockstar has confirmed.
item.content:encoded:
Rockstar's tagline calls Vice City "the darkest side of the sunniest place in America", and the state of Leonida is widely read as a fictional Florida. Everything in the real-world sections below describes actual Florida. None of it is a claim about what the game contains.

Read this first: the only game places we have verified are the state of Leonida and Vice City. Rockstar's website lists other regions, but we have not confirmed their names, so we do not repeat them. Check Rockstar's official page for the current list.

Real places that shape the picture

Florida is a long peninsula with a dense coastal south, huge wetlands inside, and a chain of islands trailing into the sea. Each of these landscapes is part of what people mean when they say "a Florida setting".

Real Florida places often associated with Leonida, and their real-world character
Real placeWhereWhat it is known for
Miami and Miami BeachSoutheast coastBeaches, nightlife, finance, a large international port
Art Deco Historic DistrictMiami Beach, along Ocean DrivePastel 1930s and 1940s hotels with neon signs
Everglades National ParkSouth Florida interiorVast subtropical wetland, sawgrass and mangroves
Florida KeysOff the southern tipIsland chain linked by the Overseas Highway
Lake OkeechobeeSouth-central FloridaThe state's largest freshwater lake
Space CoastCentral east coast, Cape CanaveralRocket launches and Kennedy Space Center

Miami, Miami Beach and Ocean Drive

Miami is the model most people name for Vice City. Across Biscayne Bay, Miami Beach holds the Art Deco Historic District, a concentration of streamlined pastel buildings from the 1930s and 1940s that was listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1979. Ocean Drive, facing the beach, is its best-known strip. The look appeared in the 2002 Vice City too, as explained in Vice City then and now.

The Everglades and Lake Okeechobee

West of the city lie the Everglades, a slow-moving "river of grass" draining south from Lake Okeechobee. Everglades National Park was established in 1947 and protects marshes, mangrove coasts and airboat country that feels nothing like downtown Miami. The contrast between glittering coast and swampy interior is a big part of Florida's identity.

The Florida Keys and the Overseas Highway

The Keys are a chain of coral islands curving southwest from the mainland to Key West. The Overseas Highway, part of US Route 1, links them with a series of bridges, the most famous being the Seven Mile Bridge. Fishing towns, marinas and long causeways over turquoise water define the area.

Culture, climate and wildlife

A Latin American gateway

Miami has deep ties to Cuba and the wider Caribbean and Latin America. Little Havana, with Calle Ocho at its centre, is the best-known Cuban-American neighbourhood, and Spanish is widely spoken across the metro area. PortMiami is often called the cruise capital of the world, and the region is a hub for trade and air travel to the south.

Sun, storms and humidity

South Florida has a tropical climate with a hot, humid wet season and a milder dry season. The Atlantic hurricane season officially runs from 1 June to 30 November, and storms are a routine part of life on the coast. The "sunniest place in America" line plays on this reputation for sunshine.

Real Florida wildlife

  • American alligators live in freshwater across the state, from lakes to golf-course ponds.
  • American crocodiles share southern Florida with alligators, one of the few places both live together.
  • West Indian manatees gather in warm springs and canals in winter.
  • Flamingos and wading birds such as herons and spoonbills feed in the shallows.

Wildlife has been discussed after the trailers, but we have not verified specific animals against an official source, so this list describes real Florida only.

How to use this page

Inspiration is not a map

Rockstar builds fictional places that echo real ones, then compresses, renames and exaggerates them for satire. A real landmark in Florida does not mean an identical copy exists in the game, and Rockstar has not published a map size or district list. Questions like these stay on what is still unknown until there is an official answer.

The series has always worked this way. Liberty City echoes New York and San Andreas echoes California and Nevada, with invented names that leave room for parody of real brands, politics and media. That habit, and the attention it draws, is part of why GTA 6 matters to so many people.

  • Confirmed game names: Leonida (state) and Vice City (main city).
  • Real-world model: Florida, with Vice City reflecting Miami.
  • Not published: map size, full region list verified by us.

Where to go next

For the series background, see how the GTA series got here. Words like "open world" are defined in the glossary, and the way we label sources is on how we verify facts. The basics, from release date to platforms, are on the GTA 6 explainer.

item.title: What we still do not know about GTA 6
item.description: A running list of what Rockstar has not announced about GTA 6: PC version, PEGI rating, PS5 Pro, online mode, file size, unlock time, map size and more.
item.content:encoded:
A good way to avoid misinformation is to know where the gaps are. The table below lists questions people search for and the honest status of each one. If a site gives a firm answer to an item marked unknown, ask for the official source.

The open questions at a glance

GTA 6 questions without an official answer, as of 14 November 2026
QuestionStatusWhat we can say
Is there a PC version?Not announcedRockstar and Take-Two list PS5 and Xbox Series X|S only
PS4 or Xbox One version?Not announcedOnly current consoles are listed
PS5 Pro enhancements?No official detailsRockstar's page reportedly says it plays best on PS5
PEGI rating?Not verifiedESRB Mature is shown on Rockstar's page
Online mode?Not announcedReported as a single-player experience
Global unlock time?Not announcedCheck your own store listing
File size?Not verifiedCheck your store listing before preloading
Map size?Not announcedSetting is Leonida and Vice City
Other region names?Not verified by usListed on Rockstar's site; check there
Story length?Not announcedAny hour count is a guess
In-game accessibility options?Not announcedConsole-level settings still apply
Demo or beta?None announcedNo public test announced
GTA Online ending?No statementContinues; no official end date found
Pre-order and sales numbers?Not publishedTake-Two says "unprecedented levels"

Why unknowns are normal

Many of these items are answered only by a store listing, a patch note or a rating board publication. For a game of this size such details often appear close to release or after it. An empty answer is not a sign of a problem; it means the publisher has not spoken yet. Rockstar has also historically kept details back until close to launch. The correct move is to wait for the primary source rather than accept a confident guess.

The gaps, topic by topic

Platforms: PC, PS4 and PS5 Pro

The only confirmed platforms are PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. People often cite "PC in 2027" or "PC in 2028", but these are speculation and we do not publish them. A PC announcement would come from Rockstar. A PS5 Pro mention appears at only one outlet and is not backed by an official enhancement list. Any website offering a "GTA 6 PC download" is therefore fake, as explained in how to avoid GTA 6 scams.

Content and rating details

The ESRB descriptors are known, but PEGI has not been verified. Read ratings and parental guidance for what to do meanwhile. We also do not know what the "in-game purchases" label refers to, or which in-game accessibility options the game offers; general console settings are covered in our accessibility guide.

Gameplay and world details

Rockstar's page confirms two protagonists, radio stations and an open world centred on Vice City. Trailers have shown other things, such as wildlife and social-media parodies, but we did not re-verify them against an official source, so we make no detailed claims about them. Names of other regions outside Vice City appear in outlets; we have not confirmed them, so this site uses only Leonida and Vice City. The real places that inspired the setting are a separate matter, described as real-world geography on Leonida's Florida roots. No map size comparison with GTA V has been published.

Release logistics

The release date, 19 November 2026, is confirmed. Less certain are the unlock time in your region and the preload start of 12 November 2026, which is reported by one outlet. Rockstar has not announced one global time, so check your store page rather than a social media post. What to do on the day is in the pre-order and preload guide.

Business details

Take-Two reaffirmed the date on 9 November 2026 and kept its net bookings guidance at US$8.0 to 8.2 billion. It did not publish pre-order counts or sales forecasts for the game itself. The context is in why GTA 6 matters.

How questions leave this page

  1. Rockstar or Take-Two publishes an answer on an official page or in a filing.
  2. We check the primary source and note the date.
  3. The item moves to "confirmed" on the relevant page, with the date in the text.

Reports from outlets stay labelled reported until a primary source exists; the labels are explained in how we verify facts.

This list reflects our sources as of 14 November 2026. Some answers may already exist on pages we did not read, so check Rockstar's page first.

Claims to treat with caution after launch

After 19 November 2026, new claims will multiply: review scores, sales records, hours played, secrets. Wait for named outlets or Take-Two filings. Early "record sales" posts without a named source are marketing talk, not data. The glossary decodes the jargon in such posts.

item.title: GTA glossary: terms you will see in GTA 6 news
item.description: A plain-English GTA glossary: Leonida, Vice City, open world, GTA Online, preload, ESRB, take-two, wanted level and other terms used in GTA 6 news.
item.content:encoded:
News about Grand Theft Auto VI uses a lot of jargon from gaming and business. Each term below gets a short definition. Where a term refers to a GTA 6 fact, we say whether it is confirmed.

The game, the series and the setting

Core terms

Terms about the game
TermMeaning
GTA 6 / GTA VIShort forms of Grand Theft Auto VI, the next main game, released 19 November 2026.
Rockstar GamesThe studio that develops the games. Rockstar is a label of Take-Two.
Take-Two InteractiveThe publisher and parent company, which reports earnings to investors.
LeonidaThe fictional US state where GTA VI is set. Confirmed.
Vice CityThe main city of the game; the name also belongs to the 2002 game Grand Theft Auto: Vice City.
Jason and LuciaThe two confirmed protagonists. Reported full names: Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos.
ProtagonistA main character the player controls.
MainlineA numbered main game, as opposed to a spin-off.
Spin-offA side game that is not a numbered entry.
Open worldA game map you can freely explore instead of following fixed levels.
SandboxA game that gives you freedom to choose what to do.
MissionA story task with a goal, as opposed to free exploration.
Side activityOptional content not required to finish the story.
Radio stationIn-game radio with music, talk and adverts. Confirmed as a feature.
Wanted levelA series mechanic where police respond to crimes. Not detailed for GTA VI.
NPCA non-player character, controlled by the game.

The series history shows where each of these ideas started.

Places and real-world references

  • Liberty City, San Andreas, Vice City: the three cities of the 1997 original; each returned in later games.
  • Los Santos: the city of GTA V, a fictional take on Los Angeles.
  • Real-world inspiration: a real place that a fictional one resembles. Leonida is widely read as a take on Florida; see Leonida's Florida roots.
  • Vice City Stories: a 2006 prequel set in Vice City in 1984, first released on PSP.

Buying, setup and safety

Buying and release

Terms about buying and release
TermMeaning
Standard editionThe base version of the game. Confirmed as a name.
Ultimate editionThe higher-priced version. Confirmed as a name; contents not verified by us.
Vintage Vice City PackThe pre-order bonus name.
Pre-orderBuying before release to secure a copy or bonus.
PreloadDownloading files before release; the game stays locked until the unlock time.
Unlock timeThe moment the game becomes playable. Not announced globally.
Day-one patchAn update released on launch day that fixes problems.
DelayA move to a later release date. GTA VI had delays, per reports.
Gone goldIndustry phrase meaning the game is finished for manufacture.
Digital codeA key to redeem a game on a console store. Reportedly in boxed copies.
StorefrontAn online shop, such as the PlayStation Store or Microsoft Store.
GTA+Rockstar's subscription service. Its link to GTA VI is unverified.
Order confirmationThe receipt from the store; keep it until the game runs. See the preload guide.

The purchase side is covered by editions explained.

Console setup terms

Terms about storage, accounts and security
TermMeaning
SSDSolid-state drive, the fast internal storage in PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
Expansion storageExtra fast storage: an M.2 drive on PS5 or a Storage Expansion Card on Xbox Series X|S.
Rest modeA low-power state in which the console can keep downloading.
Two-step verificationA second login check, such as a code, that protects an account.
PhishingA fake message or page built to steal logins or payment details.

Practical steps are on console preparation and avoiding scams.

Ratings and safety

Terms about ratings and safety
TermMeaning
ESRBEntertainment Software Rating Board, the rating body for the US and Canada. GTA VI shows Mature.
PEGIPan European Game Information, the European age rating system. Not verified for GTA VI.
Content descriptorA label that says why a game got its rating.
In-game purchasesOptional paid extras inside a game.
Parental controlsConsole settings that restrict games, spending and time.
Family accountA linked account structure used to manage children's profiles.

See ratings and parental guidance for the steps.

Online, platforms and labels

Online and hardware

Terms about modes and hardware
TermMeaning
Single-playerA game you play alone. GTA VI is reported as one.
MultiplayerPlay with others online or locally. None announced for GTA VI.
GTA OnlineThe online mode of GTA V.
Co-opPlayers team up rather than compete.
PS5, Xbox Series X|SThe two confirmed platforms.
PS5 ProA stronger PS5 model. No GTA VI enhancements confirmed.
Last-genOlder consoles, PS4 and Xbox One. Not announced.
PortA version adapted for another platform, such as PC.

More on the online question: single-player vs online.

Short phrases you may meet in comments

  • "Hype train": fast-growing excitement around a release.
  • "Leak": information that escaped before an official announcement. We do not publish leaks.
  • "Datamine": digging through game files for hidden information, often unreliable.
  • "Copium": slang for wishful thinking, common in comment sections.
  • "Launch window": the planned period for a release.

Slang changes quickly; these entries describe general internet use, not Rockstar terms.

Verification terms used on this site

  • Confirmed: stated on an official Rockstar page or a Take-Two filing.
  • Reported: published by a news outlet, not checked against an official page.
  • Unknown: not announced; shown on what is still unknown.
  • Speculation: a guess, which we do not publish as fact.

The method is in how we verify facts. Official reference: rockstargames.com/VI.

item.title: How we verify GTA 6 facts
